title: Verification never rewrites or retires a desired behavior
answers: can verify change a behavior note
what happens when the code behind a behavior changes
body: A `behavior` note is a rule a person wrote; when its deps change, verification asks whether the code still upholds it, never whether the note is right. src/ops.js:verifyNote hands every behavior to src/ops.js:verifyBehavior, whose verdicts are `holds` (re-baseline), `broken` (status `violated`, with the commit and reason; the text is left alone) and `moved` (deps re-pointed, history kept). No path sets a behavior to `invalid`, replaces its body, or lowers its confidence. The ordinary note verdicts `update` and `invalid` must never reach a behavior.
